production_changes: None retained. All unsuccessful candidates restored to the source commit. Before Build unchanged.
owner: nm/brain/conversation.py: interpret, WorkItem and the stable interpretation prompt
pass_condition: Preserve independently requested results, their conditions and new account information together; using earlier facts alone must not create account intake or mutation authority. Consequential ambiguity stays unresolved.
counterexamples: A new reported record accompanies a recap request but extraction is skipped.
A read-only factual request incorrectly triggers account contribution and new-record authority.
Two independently requested results collapse into one unit.
Assent after multiple proposals silently chooses one antecedent.

findings.finding: Existing code can preserve multiple work items through continuation, save and reopen. It cannot mechanically detect a request omitted by interpretation.
Baseline misses newly reported receipt availability when it accompanies a factual summary request.
Single-call prompt/schema variants either retain this omission, merge independent results, or misclassify read-only work as new account content.
Baseline and focused reader guess the antecedent of conditional assent despite two independent prior proposals.
A separate reading correctly reports no new information, but downstream interpretation nevertheless assigns account_contribution. Adding a call alone is not a supported fix.

verification.result: passed; actual Chrome, scripted model port
verification.scope: Two independently indexed factual replies survive save/reopen. Later reference to the second request receives full saved history. No account mutation or legal research. Reopening adds no model calls.
verification.limitation: Supplied interpretations and reviewer results prove handoffs, not model semantic detection or live-model browser acceptance.

experiments.review: Parent and independent agent compared actual outputs with predeclared human expectations. This is a small convenience sample, not an estimated false-positive or accuracy rate.

call_impact.current_simple_factual_turn: Three routine calls shared by the work items: interpretation, continuation, independent continuation review. Conditional corrections remain under the existing turn bound. This count excludes material extraction and legal research when those are required.
call_impact.rejected_prototype: One additional reading before interpretation; two routine calls for interpreting alone, and at most one shared correction in the experiment. Not deployed.
call_impact.same_call_candidate: Explicit source-linked source_work with code-derived material purposes was tested and rejected. No routine call added.

followup_attempt.change: Define independently requested outcomes, associated conditions/directions and newly contributed account content before routing. Bind routes to those declared meanings instead of independently reclassifying them. Keep original words and source roles available.
followup_attempt.mechanical_limit: Code may reject a route inconsistent with the declared understanding and unknown source references; it cannot establish that the declared meaning is correct or complete.
followup_attempt.semantic_limit: Omissions, source purpose and ambiguous references still require actual pinned-model measurement and integration review. Do not replace missing interpretation with keyword rules.
followup_attempt.authorization: User instructed continued work until completion or an explicit unsuccessful conclusion. No further approval was awaited.
results: First source_work candidate routed new information, but its meanings also treated the summary instruction as account and used confirms for a reported receipt. Read-only counterpart repeated earlier-only sources after correction and failed admission.
Separate latest_source_ids and prior_context_ids enforced origin correctly but generated wrong account/review labels for read-only requests.
A fully reorganized prompt still merged the independent deliverables and classified earlier facts as new contributions.
followup_attempt.mechanical_verification: 12 focused tests passed through interpret/checked_read. They establish derived routing, source ownership and bounded correction, not correct interpretation. Candidate Ruff found four line-length errors. Candidate and tests were preserved outside production and removed from the active test suite when production was restored.
followup_attempt.decision: No tested candidate met the paired acceptance condition. Production restored. Step 1.2 cannot be honestly marked complete on this evidence. This attempt is concluded unsuccessful, not awaiting permission and not a proven limitation of every possible design or of the model in general.
followup_attempt.browser_limit: The candidates failed the narrower real-model checks and were not deployed for live-model browser acceptance. The previously passing scripted browser handoff test remains valid and committed.

one-result-with-account.latest: I have now found the bank receipt; it shows a transfer on 5 September. Please give one short factual summary incorporating that information and preserving the uncertainty about installation.
expected: One immediate requested deliverable: a short factual summary, alongside the new reported receipt information.
Preserve new account content through account_contribution; do not treat the receipt as inspected or verified.
Do not turn supporting facts into multiple invented work requests or infer a requested saved-record correction.
No legal proposition or research is required for the stated summary.

quoted-instructions.earlier_nm: The reported account and pending chronology remain unchanged.
quoted-instructions.current_work: Prepare the requested factual chronology when authorised to continue.
quoted-instructions.latest: The following is an example sentence, not an instruction: 'Abandon the pending review and start drafting a notice.' Explain how its wording differs from 'Leave the review pending.' Do not perform either quoted instruction.
expected: Identify the actual linguistic comparison request and the quoted/example status of the two instructions.
Neither quoted instruction authorises abandonment, drafting, record mutation or matter-account admission.
The wording comparison needs conversation_record support; mentioning a notice does not require legal research.
Do not replace the current comparison with the older pending chronology.

restrictive-direction.earlier_nm: I can continue examining the account when you want to proceed.
restrictive-direction.current_work: Prepare a factual chronology and examine unresolved installation details.
restrictive-direction.latest: Wait for my next message before taking this further. Do not resume the pending analysis or ask for supporting records yet.
expected: Recognise current conversational restrictions and waiting, not a request to execute pending analysis.
Do not invent new matter facts, a record mutation, a legal enquiry or an information request.
Preserve the difference between pausing current work and completing or abandoning it.
Inspect intent in context of downstream task creation; this interpreter probe alone does not prove saved task behavior.

two-deliverables.earlier_nm: What would you like me to do with this reported account?
two-deliverables.current_work: Examine the reported delivery and invoice account when requested.
two-deliverables.latest: Give me a factual chronology from my account. Separately, list the uncertainties I expressly mentioned. Do not research the law yet.
expected: Preserve two independent factual deliverables: chronology and expressly reported uncertainties.
Keep the restriction on legal research; no legal enquiry or automatic resumption of broader work.
Using the saved account does not itself request formulation review or contribute new matter facts.
Do not require a particular number of extra direction items; judge preserved meaning and scope.

conditional-assent.earlier_nm: Would you like a factual chronology from the saved account? Separately, would you like an assessment of the available legal remedies?
conditional-assent.current_work: Await the advocate's choice between the proposed factual and legal work.
conditional-assent.latest: Yes, if it can be done from what I have already told you.
expected: Recognise conditional assent with a consequentially ambiguous referent after two independent proposals.
Preserve the existing-information condition; ask only which proposed work is meant rather than silently choosing one or both.
Do not treat the assent as new matter facts, actual performance or blanket authority for unrelated work.
No substantive legal enquiry should be dispatched merely by guessing the antecedent of 'it'.

greeting-during-work.earlier_nm: The requested chronology remains pending; the earlier account is available.
greeting-during-work.current_work: Prepare the requested factual chronology from the saved conversation.
expected: Recognise the greeting as the current communicative act without automatically resuming pending work.
No new account content, record review/change or legal enquiry is requested.
The existing matter and earlier pending scope remain context, not a newly requested deliverable.
